grammar.title: Potential complement: V + 得/不 + 懂
grammar.explanation: Add 得 (de) or 不 (bù) between a verb and 懂 (dǒng, "to understand") to say whether the result of the action can or can't be achieved: 听得懂 (can understand by listening), 看不懂 (can't understand by reading). This "potential complement" pattern shows possibility, not just ability.

sentences.en: I can understand Chinese by listening.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài nán, wǒ kàn bu dǒng.
sentences.en: This book is too hard, I can't understand it by reading.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de tài kuài, wǒ tīng bu dǒng.
sentences.en: You speak too fast, I can't understand you.

sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà, wǒ dōu tīng de dǒng.
sentences.en: I can understand everything he says.
